description: This file defines the '_ENTERPRISE_LlamaGuard' class which is a content moderation tool utilizing LlamaGuard model for safety checks of conversations. It includes methods for initializing the guard, setting prompts, and performing async safety validation.

classes.name: _ENTERPRISE_LlamaGuard
classes.description: A subclass of CustomLogger that manages content safety moderation using the LlamaGuard model, including initializing with content categories, setting prompt templates, and performing async safety checks.

methods.name: __init__(self, model_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the LlamaGuard, loading unsafe content categories from a file if specified.

methods.name: print_verbose(self, print_statement)
methods.description: Logs verbose messages and optionally prints them.

methods.name: set_custom_prompt_template(self, messages: list)
methods.description: Configures prompt templates with safety categories and conversation roles.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous safety check on the latest message using the LlamaGuard model; raises HTTPException if content is unsafe.
